close_reason: Opinion: (doctest) suffix is informative, not noise. Closed as opinion.
description: The .expect() message now reads 'all URIs in known — Ok(()) expected (doctest)'. The '(doctest)' tag is redundant — the reader can see from the surrounding code that this is a doctest. The message was changed to explain why .expect() is used rather than ?, but it should state that clearly: e.g. 'all URIs in known; should return Ok(()) — if not, doctest setup is wrong'. The current phrasing doesn't actually explain why expect is needed here.
title: doctest expect message '(doctest)' suffix is redundant noise
